messages:
opsbot: INCIDENT: gpu-pool-oversubscribe detected at 22:07 UTC — queue growth, token throttling, autoscaler failing to scale. PagerDuty alert fired.

samir: got the page, jumping in. seeing queue spike on eu-west-1 GPU pool, QPS x3 baseline.

priya: logs show autoscaler error returning provider quota errors. snippet: ```ERROR autoscaler/controller.go: provision failed: api error: quota_exceeded (code 429) provider=cloud-gpu```. 

jia: confirmed. autoscaler kept retrying but got backoff and then fell into leader election thrash. Requests piling in, many hitting throttling path.

carlos: customer-impact: app-prod route %gen latency 95th jumped from 300ms -> 12s, and we started returning 503s for long requests. Noted a few customers DMing support.

samir: initial mitigation: tempset routing policy to prefer dedicated pools in us-east to absorb load (nonideal latency for EU customers). Rolling that out now with `rb route set --prefer us-east --target gpu-dedicated`

priya: doing that now — triggering canary to 10% traffic. will monitor errors.

opsbot: deploy-bot: Routing policy change applied to 10% canary at 22:18 UTC.

jia: meanwhile tried manual scale: `kubectl scale statefulset/gpu-pool --replicas=12` but provider rejected with same quota_exceeded.

carlos: we need a fallback that doesn't require new GPU allocation. Options: 1) enable degraded-mode quantized variant (smaller VRAM) 2) shed/queue low-priority tenants 3) route to hosted fallback model (higher cost)

samir: enabling option 1 and 2 in parallel. Priya toggle quantized model variant for EU routes and Jia start tenant-priority-shed on non-SLA tenants.

priya: flipping model variant to q4_0-lite for eu-west routes. small perf hit but cuts memory footprint. Doing canary 20%.

jia: running shed command: `opsctl tenant-shed --pool eu-gpu --tenants non-sla --target 30%` — starting now.

opsbot: autoscaler-controller: leader lost lease at 22:22 UTC, restarting.

samir: good call — we're seeing immediate drop in queue length after shed + quantized canary. 95th latency down to ~1.8s, error rate dropping.

priya: customer support: advised about degraded perf, posting status page note. Pinged two affected customers directly with mitigation ETA.

carlos: can we let ops know if any long-term billing implications for routing to hosted fallback? finance flag required.

samir: yes — note it in post-incident. for now prioritize availability.

opsbot: pagerduty-bot: Incident assigned to samir, severity P1. Bridge open: https://calls.redwood/bridges/1789991111

jia: timeline quick notes: 22:07 alert; 22:10 oncall ack; 22:15 identified quota_exceeded; 22:18 canary routing; 22:22 shed + quantized; 22:28 visible recovery trend.

samir: at 22:35 autoscaler recovered some members but still under quota. We'll keep shed + q4_0 rolling until capacity confirmed.

priya: control-plane note: autoscaler should better stop aggressive retries when provider returns 429. Add exponential backoff and circuit open after X retries.

carlos: agreed. also add alert that correlates "provider_quota_errors > threshold AND queue_length rising" so we can page earlier with mitigation playbook.

samir: immediate action items before we close this bridge: 1) lift tenant-shed after capacity stable 2) rollback quantized routing once dedicated capacity available 3) raise provider quota request (ticket created) 4) postmortem to eng-runtime and infra teams 5) add autoscaler backoff fix PR

opsbot: NOTE: support note posted to status.redwood.com at 22:45 UTC: "Reduced performance in EU due to capacity provisioning errors; mitigations in progress."

jia: I'm capturing logs for postmortem: autoscaler traces, provider API responses, queue metrics, and tenant shed events.

priya: creating follow-up GH issue for autoscaler backoff and for predictive headroom calc. assigning to eng-infra.

samir: ok team — we'll keep bridge open 1 hour for polish, then convert to postmortem thread. Great quick work. :thumbsup:

carlos: postmortem will need customer impact rundown + cost delta from routing to hosted fallback (if used) + timeline and remediation owners.

samir: closing live triage at 23:40 UTC — recovery stable, no active throttling. converting to postmortem.

opsbot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity downgraded to P2 at 23:40 UTC.

priya: postmortem skeleton: cause summary, sequence of events, root cause = provider quota_exceeded combined with aggressive autoscaler retry/circuit design, mitigations executed, impact (latency and partial 503s to EU customers), action items with owners and ETA. I'll draft and share in #postmortems.

jia: adding logs + command snippets to the doc.

samir: thanks everyone. I'll own the follow-up with provider quota ticket and autoscaler PR review.

carlos: I'll coordinate customer comms and cost reconciliation.
